checks.comparison: main_theorem binds f, L, σ, ε, R, lower, x0, T, m, μ, P, g and requires: 0 < L, 0 ≤ σ, 0 < ε, 0 ≤ R; SmoothObjective (A1); LowerBounded f lower (A2); IsStochasticGradient μ f g σ (A3); marginals P.map(η ↦ η c) = μ (η ∼ D_ξ); WellFormed/IsMainBranch (computation tree and main branch); SampleIndependent at stepSize (C1); ReprContained (C2); DistanceBounded R (C3). It then takes any natural K with 4(R+1)L(f x0 − lower)/ε + 8σ²L(f x0 − lower)/ε² ≤ K, so Δ is the exact gap f(x^0) − f^*. The conclusion is integrability of ‖∇f(x^k)‖² for every k, together with (1/K) Σ_{k<K} ∫‖∇f(x^k)‖² dP ≤ ε, where x^k = vertex(stepSize…)(m k). This is Theorem 2.4 as recorded in the graph.

There are no extra hypotheses beyond the accepted graph contract. K = 0 is only possible when the gap is zero, and then the Lean value 1/0 · 0 = 0 ≤ ε matches the accepted K interpretation. I checked that the statement is provable along the planned route. With a_k, b_k, D_k, F_k the expectations, expected_step + delay_bound + window_sum + young_split give exactly the hypotheses of assembly. The derivation is A + (1 − l − 2r²)B ≤ 2Δ/γ + Kεq(1+2r) and A ≤ (1+r)(1+2r)B + 2(1+r)Kεq, with l = Lγ, r = LγR, q = Lγσ²/ε. Combining these with weights d/(c+d) and c/(c+d) cancels B regardless of its sign and reduces the claim exactly to poly_case. poly_case is true on all three faces of hcase: the minimum of rhs − lhs is 0.25, over a 401×401 grid per face and 300,000 random points. So the source constants hold.

main_theorem runs and constrains (C1) the iterates at stepSize L σ ε R, the reviewed source step. stepSize_facts records 0 < γ, Lγ ≤ 1/2, LγR ≤ 1/2, Lγσ² ≤ ε/4, and that one of these is an equality. All are true: γ equals one of the min terms, and an omitted term is replaced by 1/(2L).
No other step-size constraint is introduced.
Real-domain hypotheses (0 < L, 0 ≤ σ, 0 < ε, 0 ≤ R, 0 < γ) are exactly those of the graph. Lemmas that do not need L > 0 or σ ≥ 0 (e.g. moments) remain true for arbitrary real values.

The same stepSize appears in C1 and in the vertices of main_theorem. birch_success uses publicInput p, whose gamma is the same stepSize and whose K is horizon, and the budget fun _ => p.branch (horizon …), which is definitionally the public budget.
Existential witnesses (p, I in tree_gap/delay_bound) are structural and chosen independently of η, as the source proof requires. No conclusion is used as a hypothesis anywhere.
All seven assumption clauses appear as hypotheses of main_theorem, with nothing extra besides the marginal law (source: ξ ∼ D_ξ) and the structural tree/branch predicates.

Constants: K bound 4(R+1)LΔ/ε + 8σ²LΔ/ε². The one-step coefficient is γ/2(1 − Lγ), from −γ⟨∇f(x), ∇f(z)⟩ + Lγ²/2‖∇f(z)‖² with ⟨a,b⟩ = (‖a‖² + ‖b‖² − ‖a−b‖²)/2. The descent bound uses γL²/2‖x − z‖² and γ²Lσ²/2. The delay bound is 2γ²|I|(Σ E‖∇f(z^i)‖² + σ²). All are correct.

branch_vertex_succ gives x^{k+1} = x^k − γ g(z^k, ξ^k). advance_birch and execute_birch relate the template execution to Tree.realize. I checked them against the definition of StochasticGradient.advance in the library (advance step (K+1) call s = advance step K (call+1) (step call s)) and against birch.update/query.

The independence lemmas are true statements of the joint-law = product-law Fubini/Tonelli argument for W ⊥ Y with Y ∼ μ. indep_sample follows from Condition 1 by composition. noise_sum holds: for i < j in s, ξ^j is independent of (z^i, ξ^i, z^j), since z^0 = x0 is constant and the others are coordinates of the past tuple at j. So the cross terms vanish and each diagonal term is ≤ σ².
Node T is owned by main_theorem. The other 51 theorems are supporting propositions or execution lemmas, with no extra source result.

The repr lemmas are true. tree_gap: let m p be the deepest common ancestor. Then k − p ≤ dist ≤ R, repr(z^k) = repr(m p) + C with C ≤ B = map auxSample (Ico p k) by C2, and le_map_exists turns B − C into a subset I of Ico p k. This is the source identity eq:ITXwDTcpKnui with eq:VIHiAoGKxHvVihzN.

The library lemmas for proofs were inspected in the repository. Rennala.smooth_growth gives the smoothness upper bound, the |f| quadratic growth and the gradient growth under exactly SmoothObjective's two components. RingmasterAsgd.oracle_moments gives ∫‖g y·‖² ≤ σ² + ‖∇f y‖² under IsStochasticGradient. StochasticGradient.execute_advance rewrites execute with a single-oracle budget fun _ => K into advance, which matches execute_birch's budget fun _ => branch K. Rennala.uniform_prefix_accuracy covers the uniform index on Fin(N+1) times P, with the average (1/(N+1))Σ_j, which matches birch_success with N = K. Their statements fit the planned applications. All 428 referenced records are SHA-256 verified.

birch_success follows from main_theorem at K' = horizon + 1, where horizon ≥ bound(Δ) ≥ bound(exact gap) by monotonicity, combined with execute_birch and uniform_prefix_accuracy. Its statement is exactly spec.successful for the Convergence execution shape and the product law.
K = 0, Δ = 0, R = 0 (hzero gives z = x, an empty window) and σ = 0 are covered. window_sum handles real non-integer R, since each index lies in at most ⌊R⌋ windows.
The deferred obligation raw_rate (Theorem 2.4 with the source step, the source K bound and the source conclusion) is exactly the elaborated main_theorem statement, as checked under T/rate.

execute_birch states: for every seed i : Fin(K+1) and tape η, execute (gradientOracle P g) (birch q) (fun _ => q.branch q.K) i η = vertex(q.branch i). This is the planned execution obligation. It is true under WellFormed and IsMainBranch: the run lasts exactly branch K calls (single oracle), call k answers g(query, η k), the state hist equals realize (advance_birch), and branch i ≤ branch K (branch_mono) together with realize_stable give the node value.

birch_success is stated for valid p, any Instance I and oracle O with admissible p I O. Its conclusion is spec.successful p I (z ↦ execute O (birch (publicInput p)) (fun _ => p.branch (horizon …)) z.1 z.2) under ⟨(birch law).prod (O.law)⟩. This is exactly the Convergence success obligation with the public budget, so the wrapper only cites it.
Node T maps to main_theorem, which states Theorem 2.4 faithfully (see T/rate, T/step).

The elaborated statement of advance_birch (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: advancing birch n steps from count c and hist = realize c gives count c+n, realize(c+n) and an unchanged chosen. True by induction: birch.update with reply g(nodes(point c))(η c) is the realize recursion.

The elaborated statement of ancestor_repr (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: for an ancestor a of y, depth a ≤ depth y and repr y = repr a + C with |C| = depth y − depth a. True by induction on y.
The elaborated statement of ancestors_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: instance of fold_succ for ancestors. True.

The elaborated statement of assembly (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: Σ_{k<K} a_k ≤ Kε from the step, delay, Young and zero-delay hypotheses. True: summing gives exactly hA with Y = 2Δ/γ, and hA3 (directly for r > 0, from hzero for r = 0). hK is equivalent to Y·s ≤ Kε. Then final_combination applies. No sign condition on Δ is needed.

The elaborated statement of aux_zero (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: x^0 = z^0 = x0. True: repr(z^0) ≤ repr(m 0) = 0, so vertex_eq_repr gives x0.
The elaborated statement of birch_success (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: see obligation:public_success. True.
The elaborated statement of branch_ancestors (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ancestors(m k) = m  {0..k}. True.
The elaborated statement of branch_depth (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: depth(m k) = k. True.

The elaborated statement of branch_mono (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: the main branch is monotone. True: base(m(k+1) − 1) = m k ≤ m(k+1) − 1.

The elaborated statement of branch_repr_Ico (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: repr(m k) = repr(m p) + map auxSample (Ico p k) for p ≤ k. True by induction.
The elaborated statement of branch_repr_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: repr(m(k+1)) = auxSample k ::ₘ repr(m k). True.
The elaborated statement of branch_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: m(k+1) = (m(k+1) − 1) + 1. True because 0 < m(k+1).

The elaborated statement of branch_vertex_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: x^{k+1} = x^k − γ g(z^k, ξ^k). True from vertex_succ, because auxNode = point(auxSample).

The elaborated statement of delay_bound (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: E‖x^k − z^k‖² ≤ 2γ²|I|(Σ_I E‖∇f(z^i)‖² + σ²) with the tree_gap witnesses. True by Young, Jensen and noise_sum.
The elaborated statement of depth_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: instance of fold_succ for depth. True.

The elaborated statement of descent_point (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: f(x − γ g(y, ·)) is μ-integrable and its integral ≤ f x − γ/2‖∇f x‖² − γ/2(1 − Lγ)‖∇f y‖² + γL²/2‖x − y‖² + γ²Lσ²/2 for γ ≥ 0. True from the smoothness upper bound, unbiasedness, E‖g‖² ≤ ‖∇f y‖² + σ², the polarization identity and ‖∇f x − ∇f y‖² ≤ L²‖x − y‖². Integrability follows from the two-sided quadratic bound.
The elaborated statement of execute_birch (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: see obligation:execution. True.

The elaborated statement of expected_step (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: E f(x^{k+1}) ≤ E f(x^k) − γ/2 E‖∇f x^k‖² − γ/2(1 − Lγ) E‖∇f z^k‖² + γL²/2 E‖x^k − z^k‖² + γ²Lσ²/2. True: all integrands are integrable by moments and growth_integrable; then condition on W = (x^k, z^k) ⊥ ξ^k (indep_integral) and apply descent_point.

The elaborated statement of final_combination (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: A ≤ Kε. True: with c = 1 − l − 2r² ≥ 0 and d = (1+r)(1+2r) > 0, combine hA and hA3 with weights d/(c+d) and c/(c+d) to eliminate B (any sign). Using Y ≤ Kε/s (s = 2r + 2l + 4q > 0 by hcase), the claim reduces exactly to poly_case.

The elaborated statement of foldHist_stable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: for j ≤ k, foldHist k j = fold j. True by induction on k: the step k+1 only changes entries > k.

The elaborated statement of fold_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: fold (j+1) = step j (fold (base j)) when base j ≤ j. True from the definition plus foldHist_stable.

The elaborated statement of growth_integrable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: f(Y) and ‖∇f(Y)‖² are integrable if ‖Y‖² is (probability P). True by smooth_growth.
The elaborated statement of indep_bound (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: the nonnegative version, bounded by an integrable B. True by Tonelli.

The elaborated statement of indep_comp (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: for W ⊥ Y, Y ∼ μ, jointly measurable Φ with integrable sections and integrable ω ↦ ∫‖Φ(W ω, ·)‖dμ: Φ(W, Y) is integrable and its integral equals the iterated integral. True by joint law = map W ⊗ μ and Fubini (integrable_prod_iff, integral_prod).

The elaborated statement of indep_integral (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: the vector-valued Fubini identity under independence, given integrability of the composite. True (when E is not complete all integrals are 0 and the statement is trivial).

The elaborated statement of indep_sample (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: any measurable function of the past tuple is independent of ξ^k. True from C1 by composition and symmetry.

The elaborated statement of le_map_exists (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: a sub-multiset of s.map f is the image of a sub-multiset of s. True by induction on s using count arguments.
The elaborated statement of main_theorem (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: raw Theorem 2.4 (see T/rate).

The elaborated statement of moments (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: all second moments are finite. True by induction with moments_step and branch_vertex_succ.

The elaborated statement of moments_step (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: given ‖x^k‖² integrable and ‖g(z^i,ξ^i)‖² integrable for i < k: ‖z^k‖² and ‖g(z^k,ξ^k)‖² are integrable. True: z^k = x^k + γ Σ_I g(z^i, ξ^i) by tree_gap, and E‖g(z,ξ)‖² ≤ E‖∇f(z)‖² + σ² by independence (indep_bound with oracle_moments) and gradient growth.
The elaborated statement of noise_sum (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: E‖Σ_s (g(z^i,ξ^i) − ∇f(z^i))‖² ≤ |s|σ². True (see topic:probability).
The elaborated statement of norm_add_sq_two (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ‖x+y‖² ≤ 2‖x‖² + 2‖y‖². True.
The elaborated statement of norm_sum_sq (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ‖Σ_s F‖² ≤ |s| Σ‖F‖². True by Cauchy–Schwarz.

The elaborated statement of past_X (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: x^i (i ≤ k) is a measurable function of the past tuple at k. True: a constant for i = 0, a coordinate otherwise.

The elaborated statement of past_Z (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: z^i (i ≤ k) is a measurable function of the past tuple. True: a constant for i = 0 by aux_zero, a coordinate otherwise.

The elaborated statement of past_family (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: a uniform-in-i version of past_X/past_Z. True by choice, taking constants for i > k.
The elaborated statement of past_measurable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: the past tuple is measurable. True.
The elaborated statement of past_sample (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ξ^i (i < k) is a coordinate of the past tuple. True.

The elaborated statement of poly_case (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: polynomial inequality on the faces l = 1/2, r = 1/2 or q = 1/4 of the box. Numerically verified true with margin ≥ 0.25 (grid and random search).

The elaborated statement of realize_measurable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: node and reply values are measurable in the tape when uncurry g is measurable. True: the if-tests depend only on indices.

The elaborated statement of realize_stable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: under WellFormed, realize k agrees with vertex on nodes ≤ k and with reply on calls < k. True: step k only writes node k+1 and reply k, and point k ≤ k.
The elaborated statement of repr_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: instance of fold_succ for repr. True.
The elaborated statement of stepSize_facts (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: step-size facts. True (see T/step).

The elaborated statement of sub_sq_integrable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ‖Y − Y'‖² is integrable if ‖Y‖², ‖Y'‖² are. True for any measure, via ≤ 2‖Y‖² + 2‖Y'‖².
The elaborated statement of tree_gap (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: the source fork identity. True (see topic:representations).

The elaborated statement of vertex_eq_repr (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: vertex j = x0 − γ Σ_{c ∈ repr j} reply c. True by induction with vertex_succ and repr_succ.
The elaborated statement of vertex_measurable (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: corollary of realize_measurable. True.

The elaborated statement of vertex_succ (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: vertex(j+1) = vertex(base j) − γ reply(grad j). True under WellFormed, using realize_stable and the grad j = j case split.
The elaborated statement of vertex_zero (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: vertex 0 = x0. True by definition.

The elaborated statement of window_sum (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: Σ_{k<K} Σ_{i∈I_k} b_i ≤ R Σ_{i<K} b_i. True: each i lies in I_k only for k ∈ (i, i+R], at most ⌊R⌋ values, and b ≥ 0.

The elaborated statement of young_split (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: ρ‖u‖² ≤ ρ(1+ρ)‖v‖² + (1+ρ)L²‖x − y‖² given ‖u − v‖ ≤ L‖x − y‖. True: ‖u‖² ≤ (1+ρ)‖v‖² + (1+1/ρ)‖u − v‖² for ρ > 0, and trivially for ρ = 0.

The elaborated statement of zero_mem_ancestors (record SHA-256 verified; body is a registered sorry and was not used as evidence) says: 0 is an ancestor of every node under WellFormed. True by strong induction.

notes: poly_case and final_combination carry the refined constant argument. I checked final_combination analytically (it reduces exactly to poly_case) and poly_case numerically (min margin 0.25 on every hcase face). A machine proof of poly_case should be straightforward, e.g. nlinarith with the face substitution.

The library lemmas planned for the proofs (smooth_growth, oracle_moments, execute_advance, uniform_prefix_accuracy) were inspected in the repository source and fit their uses. Their proofs and axioms must still pass the final transitive axiom audit.
Evidence was packet records only (428 records, SHA-256 verified). The dev draft already contains some filled proofs; they were not used.
